title: Cover CLI args-file symlink refusal with an in-workspace target
outcome: The symlink integration case proves rejection is caused by link identity rather than by a target outside the workspace.
acceptance: A Unix final-component symlink to a regular JSON file inside the workspace returns exit 2 with argument_source_not_regular.

completion.summary: The CLI args-file symlink regression now points to a valid regular JSON file inside the workspace, isolating link rejection from workspace escape.
